rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something odd or idiosyncratic, without necessarily implying that it is cute.

example.english: The décor of this restaurant is really quirky.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修真係幾古怪。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 zan1 hai6 gei2 gu2 gwaai3

rows.note: Use this for a person, mannerism, or style that is weird in a playful, lively, or appealingly cute way.

example.english: My little sister is always coming up with quirky ideas.
example.traditional: 我個細妹成日諗埋啲古靈精怪嘅橋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 sai3 mui2 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 ge3 kiu2

rows.note: Use this especially when the quirky behavior or appearance seems deliberately funny, attention-seeking, or unconventional.

example.english: They deliberately wore a huge hat to be quirky.
example.traditional: 佢特登戴住頂超大帽出街搞怪。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak6 dang1 daai3 zyu6 deng2 ciu1 daai6 mou2 ceot1 gaai1 gaau2 gwaai3
